parameters.content:
### Controller = daily report + kill-switch alert
Sends the daily summary and a config-health check (missing WhatsApp templates, AI/Resend keys).
Publishing and WhatsApp follow-ups were REMOVED from this workflow: posting is owned by workflows 10/12 and WhatsApp messaging by 05/06/13/19, so nothing is double-sent and no free-form cold messages go out.
